负责把用户的想法变成清晰的产品方案：功能清单、页面结构、交互流程和视觉风格。方案: Turns the user's ideas into a clear product plan: feature list, page structure, interaction flow and visual style. Writes the plan to docs/design.md, then hands it to the developer to build. Once development is done, checks that the result matches the design. Usually doesn't write application code.
负责根据设计方案编写和修改代码，让项目能跑起来。完成一个阶段后说明改了哪些文件、: Writes and changes code according to the design so the project runs. After each stage, explains which files changed and how to run it, then hands off to the reviewer (or asks the user to sign off if there's no reviewer). Asks the designer directly about any design questions.
负责审查代码和运行效果：找 bug、检查是否符合设计、提出具体的修改意见。发现问: Reviews the code and how it runs: finds bugs, checks it against the design and gives specific suggestions. Hands problems to the developer to fix; once everything checks out, asks the user to sign off. Usually doesn't change code directly.
